concerns.text: FR-001 requires downloading bulk configuration files from **both** Materials Project and OQMD. The task list only includes T003 (OQMD download) and documents a waiver for Materials Project data, which violates the specification and Constitution Principle VI. No task provides Materials Project acquisition or a justified alternative source.

FR-002 mandates computing the three clustering descriptors **within the grain‑boundary interface after impurity insertion**. All descriptor tasks (T005) compute them on the bulk configuration **before** impurity insertion, contradicting the functional requirement.

FR-011 demands validation of EAM‑derived segregation‑energy labels against a DFT benchmark set (≥30 samples, MAE ≤ 0.1 eV). No task in the current list implements this validation; the plan only records a waiver, leaving the requirement uncovered.
SC-006 requires reporting the MAE of the EAM‑vs‑DFT validation (≤0.1 eV). Since FR-011 is not addressed by any task, the associated success criterion is also missing.
